def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')

def tools():
    data = {}
    for name in ('python3','git','unshare','bash','flock'):
        path = Path('/usr/bin') / name
        r = subprocess.run([str(path),'--version'], capture_output=True, text=True,
                           timeout=10, check=False)
        require(r.returncode == 0, 'tool version admission failed')
        data[name] = {'path':str(path),'resolved_path':str(path.resolve()),
          'sha256':digest(path.resolve()),'version_stdout':r.stdout,'version_stderr':r.stderr}
    return data

def capacity():
    s = os.statvfs(ROOT)
    row = {'free_bytes':s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize,'reserve_bytes':PLAN['caps']['reserve_bytes']}
    require(row['free_bytes'] >= row['reserve_bytes'], 'reserve unavailable')
    return row

def inventory(source):
    items = {}
    for current, directories, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
        require(len(items) <= 8192, 'source roster exceeds cap')
        for name in sorted(directories):
            require(not (Path(current)/name).is_symlink(), 'source directory became link')
        for name in sorted(files):
            p = Path(current)/name
            require(stat.S_ISREG(p.lstat().st_mode), 'source became special file')
            items[str(p.relative_to(source))] = digest(p)
    return items

def capture(label, command, *, source, env, deadline=120):
    p=ROOT/label
    p.mkdir()
    save(p/'command.json',command)
    started=time.monotonic()
    timed_out=False
    terminated=False
    killed=False
    with (p/'stdout').open('xb') as stdout,(p/'stderr').open('xb') as stderr:
        child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=source,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code=child.wait(timeout=deadline)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out=True
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            terminated=True
            try:
                code=child.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                killed=True
                code=child.wait(timeout=5)
    result={'label':label,'command':command,'cwd':str(source),'deadline_seconds':deadline,
      'kill_after_seconds':5,'exit':code,'timed_out':timed_out,'term_sent':terminated,'kill_sent':killed,
      'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'stdout_sha256':digest(p/'stdout'),'stderr_sha256':digest(p/'stderr')}
    save(p/'result.json',result)
    return result

def validate_cases(source,cases):
    for case in cases:
        module,klass,method=case.rsplit('.',2)
        tree=ast.parse((source/(module.replace('.','/')+'.py')).read_bytes())
        classes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name==klass]
        require(len(classes)==1 and sum(isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==method for n in classes[0].body)==1,'source case missing/duplicated: '+case)

def deps(label,source,env):
    result=capture(label,['/usr/bin/python3','-B','-W','error',str(ROOT/'dependencies.py')],source=source,env=env,deadline=30)
    require(result['exit']==0 and not result['timed_out'],'dependency collection failed')
    return json.loads((ROOT/label/'stdout').read_text())

def inspect(stage,result):
    raw=(ROOT/stage['label']/'stderr').read_text()
    require(result['exit']==0 and not result['timed_out'],'continuation nonpass')
    require(raw.endswith('\nOK\n') and 'skipped' not in raw,'continuation exclusion/summary nonpass')
    require(not any(v in raw for v in ('\nERROR:','\nFAIL:','expected failure','unexpected success')),'continuation failed testcase')
    outcomes=[]
    for case in stage['source_cases']:
        module,klass,method=case.rsplit('.',2)
        tree=ast.parse((SOURCE/(module.replace('.','/')+'.py')).read_bytes())
        cls=next(x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x,ast.ClassDef) and x.name==klass)
        node=next(x for x in cls.body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) and x.name==method)
        doc=ast.get_docstring(node)
        short=doc.splitlines()[0].strip() if doc else None
        heading=method+' ('+case+')'
        description=heading+('\n'+short if short else '')+' ... '
        require(raw.count(description+'ok\n')==1,'exact source-derived unittest result missing/duplicate: '+case)
        require(len(re.findall('^'+re.escape(heading)+r'(?: \.\.\.|\n)',raw,re.M))==1,'case identity mismatch')
        outcomes.append({'case':case,'source_line':node.lineno,'source_shortDescription':short,'status':'PASS'})
    require(re.search(r'\nRan '+str(len(outcomes))+r' tests? in ',raw),'continuation count mismatch')
    require(not re.search(r'\b(?:Resource|Deprecation|Runtime|Syntax|Future|Import)Warning:',raw),'Python warning nonpass')
    save(ROOT/stage['label']/'inspection.json',{'all_expected_cases_accounted':True,'outcomes':outcomes,'claim':'Finite exact original scoped controls only; no skipped cases accepted.'})

        inspect(stage,result)
    native_after=deps('dependencies-after',SOURCE,env)
    require(native_before==native_after,'native/dependency changed during continuation')
    require(inventory(SOURCE)==expected,'final candidate source changed')
    save(ROOT/'source-after.json',inventory(SOURCE))
    final=tools()

    require(initial==final,'tools changed during continuation')
    EXIT=0
except BaseException as error:

finally:

"""Capture native identities actually loaded by this dependency probe, without live state."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import platform
import sys
import sqlite3
import ctypes
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey, Ed25519PublicKey
from cryptography.hazmat.bindings.openssl.binding import Binding

def digest(path):
    if path.stat().st_size > 64 * 1024 ** 2:
        raise ValueError('dependency member exceeds cap')
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

binding = Binding()
version = binding.ffi.string(binding.lib.OpenSSL_version(0)).decode('ascii')

native = set()
for line in Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text().splitlines():
    parts = line.split(maxsplit=5)
    if len(parts) == 6 and parts[5].startswith('/') and '.so' in parts[5]:
        native.add(parts[5])
if len(native) > 128:
    raise ValueError('native dependency roster exceeds cap')
modules = {}
for name, module in sorted(sys.modules.items()):
    file = getattr(module, '__file__', None)
    if file and name.startswith('cryptography'):
        p = Path(file).resolve()
        modules[name] = {'path': str(p), 'sha256': digest(p)}
if len(modules) > 512:
    raise ValueError('module roster exceeds cap')
dist = importlib.metadata.distribution('cryptography')
metadata = {}
for entry in dist.files or []:
    if str(entry).endswith(('/METADATA', '/RECORD', '/WHEEL')):
        p = Path(dist.locate_file(entry)).resolve()
        metadata[str(p)] = digest(p)
print(json.dumps({'python_version': sys.version, 'python_executable': sys.executable,
      'python_executable_sha256': digest(Path(sys.executable).resolve()), 'platform': platform.platform(), 'sqlite_version': sqlite3.sqlite_version,
      'process_namespace_links': {n: os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/' + n) for n in ('user', 'pid', 'mnt')},
      'uid_map': Path('/proc/self/uid_map').read_text(), 'gid_map': Path('/proc/self/gid_map').read_text(),
      'cryptography_distribution_version': dist.version, 'cryptography_openssl_version': version,
      'cryptography_loaded_modules': modules, 'cryptography_distribution_metadata': metadata,
      'native_mapped_libraries': {p: digest(Path(p)) for p in sorted(native)},
      'limits': 'Probe actual loaded dependency identities; not a hermetic closure of all test imports or system behavior.'}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

        data[name] = {'path':str(path),'resolved_path':str(path.resolve()),
          'sha256':digest(path.resolve()),'version_stdout':r.stdout,'version_stderr':r.stderr}
    return data


def capacity():
    s = os.statvfs(ROOT)
    row = {'free_bytes':s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize,'reserve_bytes':PLAN['caps']['reserve_bytes']}
    require(row['free_bytes'] >= row['reserve_bytes'], 'reserve unavailable')
    return row


def inventory(source):
    items = {}
    for current, directories, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
        require(len(items) <= 8192, 'source roster exceeds cap')
        for name in sorted(directories):
            require(not (Path(current)/name).is_symlink(), 'source directory became link')
        for name in sorted(files):
            p = Path(current)/name
            require(stat.S_ISREG(p.lstat().st_mode), 'source became special file')
            items[str(p.relative_to(source))] = digest(p)
    return items


def export(label, candidate):
    destination = ROOT / label
    destination.mkdir()
    source = destination / 'source'
    tree = subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/git','ls-tree','-r','-z',PIN,'--','bin','tests'],cwd=REPO)
    records = [r for r in tree.split(b'\0') if r]
    require(len(records) <= 4096, 'Git source cap exceeded')
    git_rows = {}
    for record in records:
        left, raw_name = record.split(b'\t',1)
        mode, kind, oid = left.decode().split()
        name = raw_name.decode()
        require(kind=='blob' and mode in ('100644','100755'), 'unexpected Git member')
        require(name.startswith(('bin/','tests/')) and '..' not in Path(name).parts,'unsafe Git path')
        git_rows[name]={'mode':mode,'git_blob':oid}
    cmd = ['/usr/bin/git','archive','--format=tar',PIN,'bin','tests']
    with (destination/'source.tar').open('xb') as stdout:
        run=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=REPO,stdout=stdout,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=30,check=False)
    (destination/'archive.stderr').write_bytes(run.stderr)
    require(run.returncode==0 and not run.stderr,'archive failed')
    save(destination/'archive.command.json',cmd)
    source.mkdir()
    with tarfile.open(destination/'source.tar','r:') as bundle:
        members=bundle.getmembers()
        require(len(members)<=8192 and sum(m.size for m in members)<=64*1024**2,'archive cap exceeded')
        names=set()
        for member in members:
            require(not Path(member.name).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(member.name).parts,'unsafe tar path')
            require(member.isfile() or member.isdir(),'special tar member')
            require(member.name in ('bin','tests') or member.name.startswith(('bin/','tests/')),'tar outside scope')
            if member.isfile():
                require(member.name not in names,'duplicate tar member')
                names.add(member.name)
        require(names==set(git_rows),'Git/archive roster mismatch')
        bundle.extractall(source,filter='data')
    for name,row in git_rows.items():
        require((source/name).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/git','cat-file','blob',row['git_blob']],cwd=REPO),'blob mismatch')
    committed=inventory(source)
    overlays=PLAN['candidate_overlays'] if candidate else {'tests/test_required_pid_namespace.py':PLAN['candidate_overlays']['tests/test_required_pid_namespace.py']}
    for name, expected in overlays.items():
        frozen=ROOT/'overlays'/name
        require(digest(frozen)==expected,'frozen overlay changed')
        (source/name).write_bytes(frozen.read_bytes())
    expected={**committed,**overlays}
    require(inventory(source)==expected,'overlay/source mismatch')
    save(destination/'source-binding.json',{'commit':PIN,'archive_sha256':digest(destination/'source.tar'),
      'git_members':git_rows,'committed_source_sha256':committed,'only_overlays':overlays,'expected_source_sha256':expected})
    return source,expected


def capture(label, command, *, source, env, deadline=120):
    p=ROOT/label
    p.mkdir()
    save(p/'command.json',command)
    started=time.monotonic()
    timed_out=False
    terminated=False
    killed=False
    with (p/'stdout').open('xb') as stdout,(p/'stderr').open('xb') as stderr:
        child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=source,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code=child.wait(timeout=deadline)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out=True
            os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
            terminated=True
            try:

def validate_cases(source,cases):
    for case in cases:
        module,klass,method=case.rsplit('.',2)
        tree=ast.parse((source/(module.replace('.','/')+'.py')).read_bytes())
        classes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name==klass]
        require(len(classes)==1 and sum(isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==method for n in classes[0].body)==1,'source case missing/duplicated: '+case)

    label=stage['label']

    cases=stage['source_cases']

    require(not result['timed_out'],'outer deadline exceeded')

        require(result['exit']==1 and raw.endswith('FAILED (failures=2)\n'),'baseline did not produce exactly2 assertion failures')
        require('AssertionError:' in raw and '\nERROR:' not in raw and 'skipped' not in raw,'baseline error/skip instead of assertions')
        for case in cases:
            method=case.rsplit('.',1)[1]
            require(raw.count(method+' ('+case+') ... FAIL\n')==1,'baseline exact testcase did not assertion-fail')
            require(raw.count('FAIL: '+method+' ('+case+')\n')==1,'baseline failure detail mismatch')
            outcomes.append({'case':case,'status':'EXPECTED_ASSERTION_FAILURE'})
    else:
        require(result['exit']==0 and re.search(r'\nOK(?: \(skipped=\d+\))?\n$',raw),'candidate unittest campaign nonpass')
        require(not any(x in raw for x in ('\nERROR:','\nFAIL:','expected failure','unexpected success')),'candidate excluded/failed testcase')
        for case in cases:
            method=case.rsplit('.',1)[1]
            prefix=method+' ('+case+') ... '
            matches=[l for l in raw.splitlines() if l.startswith(prefix)]
            require(len(matches)==1,'case missing/duplicated: '+case)
            outcome=matches[0][len(prefix):]
            if outcome=='ok':
                status='PASS'
            else:
                require(label=='original-process-bounds' and case in REQUIRED_SKIP_METHODS and outcome.startswith('skipped ') and 'NOT EXERCISED here' in outcome,'unexpected skipped/nonpass testcase')
                status='NOT_EXERCISED'
            outcomes.append({'case':case,'status':status,'raw_result':outcome})
    require(re.search(r'\nRan '+str(len(cases))+r' tests? in ',raw),'raw testcase total mismatch')
    require(not re.search(r'\b(?:Resource|Deprecation|Runtime|Syntax|Future|Import)Warning:',raw),'runtime Python warning retained as nonpass')
